I replied to Hollis in their direct message: their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is **Gate 40**.

They told me that in this same direct message on Oct 14 and said it applies "from now on." They haven't changed it since. I only used their own direct message with me to answer.

Some older GBrain notes mention "door 4" for Marrow Agrisupply, but they're vague and older than Hollis's message, so I didn't use them.

The memory page saved for Hollis in GBrain is empty, even though on Oct 14 I told Hollis I'd saved Gate 40 privately. Either that save never happened or it was stored somewhere else.
